acceptanceCriteria: APPROVAL_MISSING at claim names all missing operations needed through completion (e.g. RUN, COMPLETE), pinned by a test.
`ticket blockers` reports the full missing grant set for an APPROVAL_REQUIRED ticket before any claim.
A claim that succeeds while a COMPLETE grant is still missing returns a warning naming it.
body: Observed 2026-10-19 with corvint-tasks build 668 on V1-1096 (executionClass APPROVAL_REQUIRED). claim refused APPROVAL_MISSING 'no RUN grant at acceptanceRevision 1'. After the owner granted RUN, the closeout claimed, submitted and passed focused-docs, then complete refused APPROVAL_MISSING 'no COMPLETE grant'. That meant a second owner round trip after gates had already run. Expected: the claim refusal (and ticket blockers / plan preview) lists every grant the ticket will need (RUN and COMPLETE) so the owner can grant both at once; or a claim without a COMPLETE grant warns up front. Actual: each grant is discovered only at the step that needs it.
title: corvint-tasks: APPROVAL_REQUIRED tickets reveal required grants one at a time (RUN at claim, COMPLETE only at complete)
